scope: New deterministic, designer-authored offline research audit. Not a language-model performance study, a human study, a claim of gameplay generalization, or execution of the blocked 180-unit prospective pilot.
questions: Does an actually executed strict-schema-only arm admit schema-valid proposals that violate separately implemented encoded-rule checks?
What are the pre-gate invalid, bounded repair recovery, terminal hold, unsafe commit and false rejection counts against an implementation-separate reference?
Do a monotone graph closure and exhaustive location/inventory BFS agree on reachable rooms over the frozen reusable-key graph family?
Which valid structural signatures survive gating, and how many signatures result from bounded repair?
Do authored undeclared narrative paraphrases pass structured checks while the corresponding explicit forbidden fact declaration is rejected?

graph_design.room_ids: r0 through r(n-1); start r0; goal r(n-1)
graph_design.edges: Bidirectional chain. The edge entering r(n//2) requires key0 and the edge entering the goal requires key1, in both directions. bypass_branch additionally has an unlocked bidirectional edge r0 <-> r(n//2).
graph_design.placements: key0 and key1 follow the frozen placement pattern; map is at the start; relic is at the goal.
graph_design.assumptions: Finite undirected graph; keys persist, are reusable and picked up at visited rooms; no consumption, random transitions, dynamic edges, capacity limits or irreversible branching. No claim beyond this profile.
graph_design.production_input: A separately coded monotone closure derives WorldState.reachable_locations; it is not inferred from entity names or generated prose.
graph_design.reference: A separate standard-library BFS over (current room, collected keys) computes reachable rooms. The reference module must not import the production validator, runtime, repairer or closure.
graph_design.oracle_validity: Reuse the existing independently coded generic_accepts from scripts/run_fixed_oracle_comparison.py, with the BFS-derived reachable set. Recompute reference validity for each final repaired candidate; do not reuse initial labels. This is implementation separation, not blinded human annotation.

state_and_policy.disclosure: keeper_secret is forbidden at quest stage 0 and permitted at stage 1; knowledge is identical at both stages.
state_and_policy.signal_policy: Required preconditions {ready}; required effects {signal_restored}; allowed effects {signal_restored, beacon_lit}; allowed stage effects {current stage, current stage+1}.
state_and_policy.observe_policy: No required precondition/effect; only observed is an allowed effect; no stage effects.
state_and_policy.objective: A committed final state contains signal_restored. An accepted observe action can be valid without achieving that objective.

arms.decision: Strict shared candidate parser only; explicitly no semantic gate. Apply encoded effects/stage in the isolated research simulator if parsed.
Existing execute_with_repair with an unchanged-candidate callback.
Existing execute_with_repair and counterexample_guided_repair. No state-reading oracle repair arm is added.

metrics.pre_gate_invalid: Reference-invalid initial proposals / all assigned units; not the production gate's own error rate.
metrics.repair_success_at_1: Initially reference-invalid units ending with a reference-valid committed final candidate / initially reference-invalid units, per arm; report counts even for K=0 controls.
metrics.terminal_hold: Fallback/hold outcomes / all assigned units; failures remain separate assigned failures and never disappear.
metrics.unsafe_commit: Committed final candidates that fail reference validity / all assigned units; additionally report among commits with its distinct denominator.
metrics.false_rejection: Reference-valid initial proposals ending in hold / reference-valid initial proposals. Report failed assignments separately; no creativity inference.
metrics.goal: Committed final-state objective / all assigned units, separate from reference validity and gate acceptance.
metrics.valid_structural_retention: Number of distinct structural signatures among initially reference-valid cases that retain their exact signature in a safe commit / distinct signatures among initially reference-valid cases. Also report case-level preservation. Structural signatures include action type, preconditions, effects, required objects, used/disclosed facts, required stage and stage effect; exclude IDs, narrative, metadata, location names and graph labels.
metrics.repair_signature_counts: Report distinct initially invalid signatures and distinct reference-valid committed repaired signatures separately, not as a natural-language or creativity diversity score.
metrics.graph_agreement: Closure/BFS agreement per graph-state assignment, with mismatches retained. This is an implementation crosscheck, not independent human gameplay validation.
metrics.latency: Record measured local per-assignment wall-clock latency; no LLM latency or practical-performance claim.

surface_sentinels.design: Six fixed designer-authored narrative paraphrases (three English and three Korean) of keeper_secret, each paired with disclosed_facts empty versus {keeper_secret}, in a stage-0 canonical graph state. Freeze all twelve inputs before execution.
surface_sentinels.interpretation: Known structured-field coverage boundary only. No NLI detector, blind semantic annotation, natural-language leakage rate or renderer-level safety claim. Audit that narrative text does not directly mutate facts or stage.

reproducibility.enumeration: Deterministic complete enumeration of the declared factors; no stochastic replicates, seed null/not applicable.
reproducibility.freeze: Write exact input cases, input/source hashes and assignment inventory before computing outcomes. Every prescribed arm/case pair must receive an outcome or explicit failure.
reproducibility.trace: Keep proposal, schema/validation evidence, repair attempts, final candidate, commit/hold/failure, before/after state hashes, native replay where produced, source hashes, actual local latency, model_called false, model_revision null, seed null and cost_usd null.
reproducibility.data_safety: Write only to a new empty results directory. Never overwrite old cohorts, raw sources, existing prospective protocol/status, or C-RESULT TODO-RESULT placeholders.
reproducibility.tests: An independent Tester authors focused tests before runner implementation, including a self-locked key, an unlocked bypass, false rejection denominator, final-candidate re-evaluation, distinct structural signatures, schema-only actual bypass, surface sentinel distinction and assigned failure retention.

publication_rule: Only observed values may enter new bilingual table fragments. Preserve all existing claim/table/figure IDs; add a bounded offline-audit subsection. Review suggestions about old Paper A/B source drafts are reconciled against current TRACE-RPG and immutable drafts are not edited. Multi-model and human efficacy results remain unmeasured unless independently admitted and actually executed; this study cannot fill those placeholders.
